en: %s dusts the base of the artifact.
Captains, send forth your first combatants.
Come, little ones.
Over in the Hall of Arms you can find our resident stable master, Ulbrek Firehand.  He'll make sure any pets ye have are well fed and rightly cared for.
I am with you until I gasp my last dying breath.
My... My powers have diminished... You shall pay for this insolence!
This is a shiney rock, I'll put it in my bucket. Ok, I just need a few more...
Pledge your allegiance to Hakkar and the pain you suffer shall be minimal.
People think I like corndogs, but actually, they give me indigestion !!!
How?? Well, it's a long story.
All the fisherman have moved to Darnassus with the recent attacks around Lake Al'Ameth.  You should try looking for someone to train you there.
Thank you, kind stranger. May your heroism never be forgotten.

The felhound... a vicious creature indeed. It is not as physically strong as an infernal, but a wise warlock knows that brute force is not always the answer--if it was, you would have chosen the path of a warrior instead, wouldn't you?$B$BThe felhound draws upon the mana of its foes, using that and its quickness to overcome enemies. Its strength comes from the arcane and using that arcane power for its own ends.$B$BIf you wish to know more about infernals, then you should speak to Magaz across from me.
%s whimpers.
I lived in Dire Maul for a little bit.  That was fun.  Really.

If there's one thing time has taught me it's that no assignment is a dull one.  Protecting the Thandol Span should have been an easy task.  But with the brunt of the army fighting alongside the alliance, we were overwhelmed here and Dun Modr has fallen.
Feeling underpowered
Game? Are you crazy?
And they're off!

Looks like the last of the goods we've collected is going to be shipped out to Silithus sometime in the next day. And once that's done, someone will have to come along and ring the gong on the Scarab Dais, outside of Ahn'Qiraj, to open the gates. That's when our bandages will come in handy.
A darkness had fallen over my eyes, but you tore me from my unholy reverie.  You saved me, $n.$B$BAnd now I beg you... to forgive me.
The Affray has begun.  $n, get ready to fight!

At last! Someone to free me from this cell!$b$bHigh Executor Hadrec sent us to gather information on the Keep so that a plan could be formulated to overthrow Arugal once and for all.$b$bBut the old wizard has many tricks up his sleeve and we were detected by a magical ward. I was thrown in this prison. Vincent was not so lucky.$b$bI must return to Hadrec to debrief him at once. But first I will pick the lock to the courtyard door for you. Perhaps you can try your luck against the foes that lurk beyond.
Hopefully I can send a worthy few to help Ashenvale and the Sentinels.
I had to go and requisition an Abomination... an Abomination!
Never cross a Dark Iron, $C.
Oh well.
Any one else ready to feel the wrath of the Defias Brotherhood?

Whoa now, $c, Pele'keiki thinkin' that you not knowin' all that stuff be on its way to Silithus. Pele'keiki told the last of it be getting' there in less than a day, and after that some misguided fool gonna ring the gong outside the Ahn'Qiraj gates to open 'em up and be startin' the war.
Greetings $c, I am the leatherworking trainer for Darnassus.  What may I assist you with?
Carrots every day for a year if you stop!
Who do I kill? Just point me in their direction, Commander.
Gimme the hippogryph hatchling!
Rin'wosho, I require repairs.
Which battleground are you interested in?
